objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: on twist tubes of 4 to 12 rings at g = 2 and 4 to 8 at g = 3 and 4, insert one ring after ring 0 at every lag of the run's state cycle, with the rewired contacts keeping their values or born fresh, and read whether every contact persists, and which bindings of reached rings, rings not reached and the new ring survive; hypotheses frozen in the contract.
title: What survives a ring inserted while the twist tube runs: a census
